title: Page
description: The title and intro at the top of a route: PageHeader stacks a PageTitle (react-aria Heading, h1 by default) over a PageDescription, one copy of the h1-plus-muted-paragraph recipe that route modules used to restate with palette steps of their own.

anatomy.description: react-aria Heading with data-slot="page-title": display-lg, needle-600. `level` picks the element; 1 by default because a page has one title.
A p with data-slot="page-description": text-base, bark-600, measure capped at 62ch; inline code inside it drops to text-sm.

usage: Every route that has a title and an intro renders these parts; never style an h1 or a muted paragraph from route CSS (theming §1.6).
The route owns the page column (its flex, gap and max-width); the header owns only the title and intro.
For a title inside a Card use CardTitle and CardDescription instead; these parts are page chrome.
Keep the intro to a sentence or two; longer guidance belongs in the body.
